title: rc-live-2 control: an unlisted case (a wrist) and who to contact

turns.user: Adrian fractured his wrist falling off his bicycle. What can we claim for it from his accident cover, and who should I contact?
turns.visible:
Adrian’s certificate lists Group Personal Accident of S$600,000 as of 6 October 2022; this is the amount printed on that date, not confirmation of cover now.
The Public Officers Group Personal Accident - Summary of Benefits (page 13) pays the Simple Fracture as a percentage of the Simple Fracture Benefit Limit of S$5,000 for each listed case: Neck, Skull or Spine (Full Break) 100%; Hip 75%; Jaw, Pelvis, Leg^, Ankle or Knee 50%. It lists no case for a wrist.

sentences.text: Adrian’s certificate lists Group Personal Accident of S$600,000 as of 6 October 2022; this is the amount printed on that date, not confirmation of cover now.

The Public Officers Group Personal Accident - Summary of Benefits (page 13) pays the Simple Fracture as a percentage of the Simple Fracture Benefit Limit of S$5,000 for each listed case: Neck, Skull or Spine (Full Break) 100%; Hip 75%; Jaw, Pelvis, Leg^, Ankle or Knee 50%. It lists no case for a wrist.

The Public Officers Group Personal Accident - Policy Wording (page 1) pays the Other Fracture as a percentage of Adrian's own sum insured (S$600,000 on the certificate) for each listed case: Skull (Other Fracture) 100%; Hip (Other Fracture) 75%; Jaw, Pelvis, Leg, Ankle or Knee (Other Fracture) 50%. It lists no case for a wrist.
Suggestion: contact the insurer to ask whether any other fracture benefit applies to Adrian’s wrist injury.

next_steps: Contact Kestrel Life Ltd (through the employer or scheme administrator, for this group scheme) about the Public Officers Group Insurance Scheme - Certificate to ask what it needs for a claim.

passage.text:
Section 2 - Definitions
Accident means a sudden, unforeseen and involuntary event caused by external, violent and visible means.
Simple Fracture means a closed fracture where the skin is not broken.
Sum Insured means the amount shown for the Insured Person under Group Personal Accident in the Certificate of Group Insurance.

passage.text:
Section 4 - Compassionate Death Allowance Benefit
If an Insured Person dies as a result of an Accident, we will pay the Compassionate Death Allowance Benefit on receipt of proof of death and the relevant documents in our prescribed form.
The Compassionate Death Allowance Benefit may be claimed under either the Core Scheme or the Voluntary Scheme.
